description: Clamps the low word to 0 to 199 and the high word to 0 to 319, with negative values replaced by 1, then returns a 64-bit pair holding a base address plus the row times 160 plus the column halved and rounded down to a multiple of eight.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:14254
name: compute_record_plane_address
description: Reads a base address from a record, adds a column offset taken from a 16-bit field that is halved and rounded down to a multiple of eight, and adds the product of two other 16-bit fields of the record.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:14312
name: convert_words_to_four_bitplanes

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:144C6

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:1461A

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:14650

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:14674

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:146CC

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:146E0

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:146EC

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:147A8

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:14866

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:1488C

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:1489C
